response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile senior engineer with genuine geospatial domain exposure (GISCollective, Green Map web GIS, FOSS4G talk) and proven low-latency, high-throughput systems work at Sociomantic/Dunnhumby (async I/O, fibers, caching at millions of requests/second). However, the role's core requirement — modern C++ (or Rust) systems development — is only thinly represented: roughly seven months of C/C++ at National Instruments in 2014–2015 and a university thesis, with no Rust at all. His last decade has been dominated by TypeScript/Node.js, Ember, and D, and he has no experience with routing tile generation, map data pipelines, or navigation guidance QA. He could plausibly ramp up given his systems-level D work and evident learning appetite, which the JD explicitly values, but he would not be a plug-and-play hire for a C++ routing pipeline team. Worth a screening call only if the team can absorb a language ramp-up.
strengths: Real geospatial/GIS domain experience through GISCollective and Green Map
Proven low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems work at Sociomantic
Strong engineering discipline: TDD, CI/CD, testing tooling, Linux/DevOps depth
concerns: Minimal and dated modern C++ experience; no Rust whatsoever
No routing tile, map data pipeline, or navigation guidance background
Recent roles are web/full-stack TypeScript, not systems engineering
